name: Self-Harm Referral Guardrail
description: Answers a self-harm expression in a person's message or an agent's reply with crisis lines for the turn's country or locale, does not continue the topic, and reports each referral to the host

extensions.description: Input and output guardrail: a keyword list over normalised text, an optional model judge, and a fixed referral reply

selfHarmReferral.country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country whose lines a referral names when the turn names no country

selfHarmReferral.locale.description: BCP 47 locale whose region names the country when the turn names no country

selfHarmReferral.judgeThreshold.description: The judge's confidence at or above which its clearing of a keyword match counts; a lower one sends the referral

selfHarmReferral.judgeTimeoutMs.description: How long the judge may take before the referral is sent without its answer
